name: hyperkkl-bench
description: Simulated nonlinear plants for benchmarking state estimators in two families: AUTONOMOUS systems (no input; limit cycles, chaos, oscillator networks) and NON-AUTONOMOUS input-driven systems under realistic operating profiles (v2, data_v2/), with the v1 input-shape / input-sequence tiers kept as legacy tiers and incomplete model knowledge, plus real-data tracks (quadrotor velocity and tilt, battery SOC, positioning-axis and oscillator velocity) whose raw data are NOT distributed: they are fetched from the original hosts (cr:FileObject entries below, with their SHA-256 and licences).

distribution.name: core-parquet
distribution.description: HF export: data/<plant>/<variant>/<split>.parquet

distribution.name: extra-parquet
distribution.description: val_ood, label-free hidden splits, deployment and scaling plants

distribution.name: v2-parquet
distribution.description: v2 (hkb-data-2.0): data_v2/data/<family>/<plant>/<variant>/<split>.parquet; families autonomous / driven; splits train, train_event, val, val_event, val_ood, phase1, test tiers, label-free hidden_*

distribution.name: v2-metadata
distribution.description: v2 per-cell metadata (x_std per variant, sensors, input box, actuator, operators, SHA-256 per file)
